# Packing checklist

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/packing-checklist/

Build and check a customizable packing list for a trip. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Choose a beach or business starter list, add personal items and export the completed checklist.

## Limits and checks

Starter lists are suggestions and cannot cover every destination’s weather, entry requirements or personal medical needs.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
